subject: general
question: In a two stroke petrol engine, during the upward stroke of the piston, the gases are compressed in the piston, and at the same time, which of the following is also performed during the operation?

options.text: Fresh air and fuel (petrol) mixture enters the crank chamber through the valve.
Fresh fuel enters in the cylinder from the crank chamber through the valve.
Fresh air for petrol engine enters the cylinder from the chamber through the valve exhaust port.
Exhaust gases enter the crank chamber through the valve.

solution:
The correct answer is __Fresh air and fuel (petrol) mixture enters the crank chamber through the valve**.**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Two-stroke petrol engine__ operates differently compared to a four-stroke engine.
 
• During the upward stroke of the piston, the fuel-air mixture is compressed in the cylinder.
 
• Simultaneously, fresh air and fuel mixture enters the crank chamber through the valve.
 
• The crank chamber plays a crucial role in the operation of the two-stroke engine.
 
• Unlike a four-stroke engine, the exhaust and intake occur in the same cycle without separate strokes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Two-Stroke Engine:**
 
 
• A two-stroke engine completes the intake, compression, power, and exhaust processes in only two strokes.
 
• It is used in small vehicles such as motorcycles and scooters due to its lightweight design.
 
 
 
• **Crank Chamber Functionality:**
 
 
• The crank chamber acts as a temporary storage for the air-fuel mixture before it enters the cylinder.
 
• The design of the chamber ensures efficient mixing and transfer of the fuel-air mixture.
 
 
 
• **Applications of Two-Stroke Engines:**
 
 
• Widely used in motorcycles, chainsaws, and marine vessels for their compact size and simplicity.
 
• Provides higher power-to-weight ratio than four-stroke engines.
